heading.en: Birth, schooling and early cavalry service

body.zh-Hant: 路易二世1870年7月12日生於巴登-巴登，是摩納哥親王阿爾貝一世與瑪麗-維多利亞·德·道格拉斯-漢密爾頓之子。他在巴黎的斯坦尼斯拉斯學院受教育，之後進入聖西爾陸軍軍官學校與索米爾騎兵學校，在法國陸軍非洲騎兵部隊服役到1899年。
body.en: Louis II was born in Baden-Baden on 12 July 1870, the son of Prince Albert I of Monaco and Marie-Victoire de Douglas-Hamilton. He was educated at the Collège Stanislas in Paris, then attended the military school of Saint-Cyr and the cavalry school at Saumur, and served in the cavalry corps of the French Army in Africa until 1899.

heading.en: The 1911 constitution, the First World War and Upper Silesia

body.zh-Hant: 1911年1月5日的摩納哥憲法，他曾參與起草。1914年大戰爆發時，他向法國自願請纓，在第五軍司令部服役；停戰後，他在協約國聯合委員會的上西里西亞任務中擔任要職。
body.en: He contributed to the drawing-up of the Monegasque Constitution of 5 January 1911. When war came in 1914 he offered his services to France and served at the headquarters of the Fifth Army; after the Armistice he filled an important post with the Inter-Allied Commission in Upper Silesia.

heading.en: Succession and the building of the reign

body.zh-Hant: 路易二世1922年6月26日繼承父位。同年他晉升為准將，1939年升任少將（Général de Division）。在位期間，摩納哥興建了司法宮與以他命名的奧林匹克體育場，他也支持設立講座協會、國家美術館與巴黎的摩納哥大學城。
body.en: Louis II succeeded his father on 26 June 1922. In 1922 he was promoted brigadier general and in 1939 général de division. During his reign Monaco built its Palace of Justice and the Olympic Stadium that bears his name, and he supported institutions such as the Société des Conférences, the National Museum of Fine Arts and the Cité Universitaire de Monaco in Paris.

heading.en: The International Hydrographic Bureau and his death

body.zh-Hant: 路易二世支持國際水文局，提供其辦公大樓：1929年4月20日奠基，1931年1月14日落成啟用。他並主持1929、1932、1937與1947年國際水文會議的開幕。他於1949年5月9日在親王宮逝世，5月17日出殯，安葬於摩納哥主教座堂的地下室。
body.en: Louis II took a considerable interest in the International Hydrographic Bureau and provided its office building: he laid the foundation stone on 20 April 1929 and inaugurated it on 14 January 1931. He presided over the opening sessions of the International Hydrographic Conferences of 1929, 1932, 1937 and 1947. He died at his palace on 9 May 1949; the funeral took place on 17 May and he rests in the crypt of Monaco Cathedral.

body.zh-Hant: 吉格梅·旺楚克1905年出生，是烏金·旺楚克的次王后阿熙·楚杜·拉姆所生之子。兩年後父親被擁戴為不丹第一位世襲君主，他成為王儲。他七歲起受教育，在亭列拉登學校學習印地語、英語與不丹傳統科目。1919年他才14歲，便被任命為通薩內務官（Trongsa Droenyer）；1922年王后去世後的次年，他受封為通薩總督（Trongsa Poenlop）。
body.en: Jigme Wangchuck was born in 1905, the son of Ugyen Wangchuck and his second queen, Ashi Tsundrue Lhamo. Two years later he became Crown Prince when his father was acclaimed as the first hereditary monarch of Bhutan. His schooling began at the age of seven, and at the Thinlay Rabten school he was taught Hindi and English besides traditional Bhutanese subjects. In 1919, aged only 14, he was appointed Trongsa Droenyer; the year after the Queen died in 1922 he was installed as Trongsa Poenlop.

heading.en: Accession, coronation and the British honour

body.zh-Hant: 1926年烏金·旺楚克去世時，22歲的王儲登上金座。1927年3月14日，在父親去世僅約半年後，他於普那卡被加冕為第二任不丹國王（Druk Gyalpo）；英國政府派出由錫金政務官貝利率領的代表團出席，並贈予印度帝國勳章（C.I.E.）。1927年3月11日的《倫敦公報》也列出「不丹的大君吉格梅·旺楚克殿下」為該勳章的受勳者。同年稍後，他與阿熙·彭措·卓登成婚。
body.en: When Ugyen Wangchuck died in 1926 the 22-year-old Crown Prince ascended the Golden Throne. On 14 March 1927, barely six months after his father's death, he was crowned the second Druk Gyalpo at Punakha; the British Government sent a delegation led by F. M. Bailey, the Political Officer in Sikkim, and offered him the insignia of a Companion of the Indian Empire (C.I.E.). The London Gazette of 11 March 1927 likewise lists His Highness Jigme Wangchuk, Maharaja of Bhutan, as a Companion of that Order. Later in the year he married Ashi Phuentsho Choedon.

body.zh-Hant: 即位後，他把地方宗本與總督的任命權收歸國王，使王權在全境居於絕對優勢；他以減輕人民稅負為主要目標，並廢除了較嚴酷的傳統刑罰。他一生只兩度出訪印度，第二次是1935年應總督邀請赴加爾各答。1947年，最後一位訪不丹的英國政務官霍普金斯向他呈贈印度帝國高級爵士勳章（K.C.I.E.）。1949年8月8日，印度與不丹在大吉嶺簽署條約，取代1910年的普那卡條約，條約並把德奧唐歸還不丹。
body.en: After his accession he made the appointment of regional poenlops and district dzongpoens the sole prerogative of the King, establishing the total supremacy of the monarchy; his primary aim was to reduce the tax burden on the people, and he abolished harsh traditional punishments. He made only two visits to India in his reign, the second to Calcutta in 1935 at the Viceroy's invitation. In 1947 A. J. Hopkins, the last British Political Officer to visit Bhutan, presented him with the insignia of a Knight Commander of the Indian Empire (K.C.I.E.). On 8 August 1949 the India-Bhutan treaty was signed at Darjeeling, replacing the Punakha Treaty of 1910; Deothang was returned to Bhutan.

body.zh-Hant: 1951年，他已因健康轉壞而無法出席在帕羅舉行的王儲婚禮。1952年3月，他在昆嘎拉登宮病逝；王儲吉格梅·多吉·旺楚克繼位。
body.en: By 1951 his health had deteriorated and he was unable to attend the wedding of the Crown Prince at Paro. He died in March 1952 at the Kuenga Rabten Palace, and Crown Prince Jigme Dorji Wangchuck succeeded to the throne.

body.zh-Hant: 貝利薩里奧·波拉斯1856年11月28日生於洛斯桑托斯省首府拉斯塔夫拉斯。德國國家圖書館的權威檔稱他為法學家、政治家，並記有「共和國總統」與作家的身分。他在主權州時期擔任過多項司法職務，很年輕時就與自由黨有所聯繫。
body.en: Belisario Porras was born on 28 November 1856 in Las Tablas, capital of Los Santos province. The German National Library authority record describes him as a jurist, politician, president of the republic and writer. Under the Sovereign State period he held several judicial posts, and from a very young age he was linked to the Liberal Party.

heading.zh-Hant: 自由黨革命與喪失公民權
heading.en: The Liberal revolution and loss of citizenship

body.zh-Hant: 波拉斯在1901年領導自由黨革命，但1903年他反對在美國主導下的巴拿馬獨立，擔心巴拿馬會淪為美國的殖民地。因此他被褫奪公民權一年，自1905年11月15日起至1906年9月13日為止。
body.en: Porras headed the Liberal revolution in 1901, but in 1903 he opposed Panamanian independence under U.S. auspices, fearing that Panama would become a colony of the United States. As a result he was stripped of his citizenship for one year, from 15 November 1905 to 13 September 1906.

fearing that Panama would become a colony of the United States
he was stripped of his citizenship for one year

body.zh-Hant: 波拉斯1912年首次當選總統。1918年，繼任者拉蒙·馬克西米利亞諾·巴爾德斯去世後，他以第一副總統身分再度出任總統、完成任期，過程中有舞弊指控，美國為維持秩序而出面干預。1920年他再當選一個任期。條目把他的三個任期記為1912至1916年、1918至1920年與1920至1924年。
body.en: Porras was first elected president in 1912. In 1918, after the death of his successor Ramón Maximiliano Valdés, he assumed the presidency again as first vice president to finish Valdés's term, amid charges of fraud, and the United States intervened to maintain order. In 1920 he was elected to another term. The entry gives his three terms as 1912-1916, 1918-1920 and 1920-1924.

heading.zh-Hant: 現代化建設與法典編纂

body.zh-Hant: 波拉斯是同時擁有城市與農村支持者的民粹領袖，靠親族教父（compadrazgo）網絡維持領導地位。他組建了民事登記、國家檔案館與國家銀行，興建奇里基鐵路，並把彩券收歸國有。1913年11月6日他成立全國委員會起草巴拿馬法典，工作在1916年完成，1916年8月22日第1號法律通過行政法典。
body.en: Porras was a populist leader with both an urban and a rural following, and he kept his leadership through the system of compadrazgo. He organised a civil registry, the national archives and the national bank, built the Chiriquí Railroad and nationalised the lottery. On 6 November 1913 he set up a national commission to draft a Panamanian legal code; its work was completed in 1916, when Law 1 of 22 August 1916 approved the Administrative Code.

heading.en: Assessment of his government and death

body.zh-Hant: 巴拿馬大學的埃爾維婭·萊蒂西婭·威廉斯寫道，波拉斯執政期間主導了全國政治舞台，推動前所未有的改革與現代化；他創設公共登記處與民事登記處、國家檔案館，並於1916年籌辦全國博覽會以紀念南海的發現。他於1942年8月28日去世。
body.en: Elvia Leticia Williams of the University of Panama writes that during his government he dominated the national political scene and undertook an unprecedented programme of reform and modernisation; he founded the Public Registry and the Civil Registry and the National Archives, and organised the National Exhibition of 1916 to commemorate the discovery of the South Sea. He died on 28 August 1942.

citations.quote: Durante su gobierno, dominó el panorama político nacional
emprendió una obra reformista y modernizadora sin precedentes
fundó el Registro Público y el Registro Civil, los Archivos Nacionales
organizó la Exposición Nacional de 1916
para conmemorar el descubrimiento del Mar del Sur
fallece el 28 de agosto de 1942
